name: Steel and Metal Service Center
old_description: From Iron-workers, Industrial Contractors to Weekend Warriors – Your One-Stop Shop for Metal, Welding, Hardware, and More!
about:
Steel and Metal Service Center operates from New Castle, Delaware, serving customers through its ShopMetal.com online platform. The company positions itself as a one-stop shop for metal, welding, hardware, and related supplies, catering to iron-workers, industrial contractors, and weekend warriors alike.

The business distributes a broad range of metal products including structural shapes (angles, beams, channels, flat bar, pipe, tube, sheet, and plate) in aluminum, galvanized, stainless, and carbon steel grades. Beyond raw metal, the catalog extends to welding consumables, safety equipment, hand tools, fasteners, material handling gear, and roofing and siding materials. A notable service is its point-of-use inventory management system, which uses smart bins with real-time visibility to automate replenishment for manufacturing and industrial operations.

Customers span automotive maintenance and towing, trailer component fabrication, pallet racking, marine and boating, concrete and masonry, cargo control, equipment construction, hand rail installation, and facility and grounds maintenance. The company also targets industrial contractors and DIY enthusiasts through its retail-oriented product assortment.

ShopMetal emphasizes priority customer service and a "Never Run Out. Always Restocked." promise, backed by its smart bin technology that aims to keep production lines moving without manual reordering.
